description: This file provides utility functions for managing local heavy check processes, including lock acquisition, environment policy application, and system interactions such as file system and process management, primarily used in testing or development workflows within the project.

methods.name: isLocalCheckEnabled
methods.description: Determines if local check is enabled based on environment variable.

methods.name: hasFlag
methods.description: Checks if an argument list contains a specific flag or option.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Modifies environment variables and arguments for local tsgo policy.

methods.name: applyLocalOxlintPolicy
methods.description: Applies environment and argument modifications for local oxlint policy.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock for heavy local checks, managing lock files and process ownership.

methods.name: resolveGitCommonDir
methods.description: Resolves the Git common directory by invoking `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`.
